description:
Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

opencodex is a universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Grok Build: a local proxy that lets them run on many different LLM providers from a single port, translating between API wire formats.

Features:
- Works with Anthropic, Google, xAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Azure, DeepSeek, Ollama, and 40+ other built-in providers.
- Supports streaming, tool calls, reasoning, and images.
- Handles OAuth logins and a ChatGPT account pool.
- Native model picker in the Codex app, sub-agents, and search/vision sidecars.
Published to npm as @bitkyc08/opencodex@2.91.0 with dist-tag latest.
New Features
- Passive GET /api/quota-pool (ocx.quota-pool/1 producer) (#7476)
- Advertise peer features from one registry (#7477)
- Parity on apply — restart the Child runtime, record and report the apply (OCX-6) (#7484)
- Name the serving Home in x-opencodex-served-by (OCX-2) (#7490)
- Mark provider list rows active when they serve (OCX-12) (#7492)
- Report each Child version and a compatibility verdict in ocx link status (#7494)
- Passive ocx service status --json and install-method verdict in ocx status --json (#7483)
- OCX-11 fallback off per scope, with home_unreachable on Children (#7482)
Bug Fixes
- Clear high-severity audit findings blocking the 2.90.0 release (#7480)
- Arm the real-home write guard when bun test skips the preload (#7467)
- Refuse Codex runtime AgentAssertion auth and scope dual_header assertions to Direct (#7470)
- Handle Codex 0.164 request controls (#7473)
- Carry Anthropic thinking signatures through reasoning_details (#7469)
- Adopt a concurrent winner's identity instead of refusing it (#7489)
- Scope queue_full to the waiting identity; address #7474 review (#7493)
- Refuse Windows Children with a Hub-mode pointer and explain existing ones (#7496)
Chores
- Cover Claude CLI JSON schema contract (#7387)
- Make update recovery, messages cancellation, and CLI parity harnesses deterministic (#7468)
- Let the test-scoped Windows ACL belt through the host-free helper (#7487)
- Place PATH-Bun fixtures under a trusted ancestry (#7466)
- Flag Windows-sensitive PRs for a lane=all dispatch (policy unchanged) (#7488)
- Expect the platform's exit signal for a replacement that ignores SIGTERM (#7502)
- Make ten Windows-sensitive flaky tests deterministic (#7501)
- Flag process-signal code as Windows-sensitive (#7503)
Other Changes
- Open dev at 2.91.0 before releasing 2.90.0 (#7475)
- Promote dev 1025acd4b1 to main as 2.91.0 (#7530)
